correctness.rationale: All 8247 faces, 4080 matched pairs and 40014 Hasse incidences exhaustively certified acyclic. Independent mod-two ranks and 171 signed Lefschetz computations agree with the claimed homology and character.

value.rationale: A canonical doubly regular tournament yields a complete, integral mixed-dimensional homotopy type and explicit rational symmetry-character distributions. The invariant rank dichotomy (one fixed H2 class but no fixed H3 class) is substantive information not entailed by Betti numbers or earlier directed-flag calculations; no unnecessary arbitrary parameter slice or family extrapolation is used.
